   111	/-! ## The transition cocycle on a finite localization cover -/
   112	
   113	namespace IsLocalization.AwayCover
   114	
   115	open Module
   116	
   117	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type u}
   118	variable (f : ι → A)
   119	variable (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (S i)]
   120	  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)]
   121	variable (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra A (T i j)]
   122	  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (f i * f j) (T i j)]
   123	variable (W : ι → ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j k, CommRing (W i j k)]
   124	  [∀ i j k, Algebra A (W i j k)]
   125	  [∀ i j k, IsLocalization.Away (f i * (f j * f k)) (W i j k)]
   126	variable {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
   127	
   128	variable (e : ∀ i, (S i ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[S i] S i)
   129	
   130	/-- The **transition cocycle** of a family of trivializations on a finite localization
   131	cover: on each overlap, the transition unit between the pushforwards of the two
   132	trivializations. -/
   133	noncomputable def trivializationCocycle (i j : ι) : (T i j)ˣ :=
   134	  transitionUnit (trivializationPush (inclLeft f S T i j) (e i))
   135	    (trivializationPush (inclRight f S T i j) (e j))
   136	
   137	/-- The defining property of the transition cocycle on the tensors `1 ⊗ₜ n`. -/
   138	lemma trivializationCocycle_mul (i j : ι) (n : N) :
   139	    (trivializationCocycle f S T e i j).val * inclLeft f S T i j (e i (1 ⊗ₜ n))
   140	      = inclRight f S T i j (e j (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
   141	  have h := transitionUnit_mul_apply (trivializationPush (inclLeft f S T i j) (e i))
   142	    (trivializationPush (inclRight f S T i j) (e j)) (1 ⊗ₜ n)
   143	  rwa [trivializationPush_one_tmul, trivializationPush_one_tmul] at h
   144	
   145	/-- The transition cocycle is a Čech cover cocycle: the diagonal and cocycle conditions
   146	follow from the transition-unit calculus and uniqueness of `A`-algebra maps out of
   147	localizations. -/
   148	theorem isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle :
   149	    IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) (trivializationCocycle f S T e) := by
   150	  constructor
   151	  · -- diagonal: the two pushforwards to `T i i` agree, so the transition unit is `1`
   152	    intro i
   153	    have hlr : inclLeft f S T i i = inclRight f S T i i :=
   154	      (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f i))).elim _ _
   155	    have h1 : trivializationCocycle f S T e i i = 1 := by
   156	      rw [trivializationCocycle, hlr, transitionUnit_self]
   157	    rw [h1, Units.val_one, map_one]
   158	  · -- cocycle: push all three transition units to the triple overlap and telescope
   159	    intro i j k
   160	    -- canonical pushforwards of the three trivializations to the triple overlap
   161	    set ρi : S i →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i j) with hρi
   162	    set ρj : S j →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i j) with hρj
   163	    set ρk : S k →ₐ[A] W i j k := (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T j k) with hρk
   164	    have key : Units.map (face₂₃ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
   165	          (trivializationCocycle f S T e j k)
   166	        * Units.map (face₁₂ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
   167	            (trivializationCocycle f S T e i j)
   168	        = Units.map (face₁₃ f T W i j k).toRingHom.toMonoidHom
   169	            (trivializationCocycle f S T e i k) := by
   170	      rw [trivializationCocycle, trivializationCocycle, trivializationCocycle,
   171	        ← map_transitionUnit, ← map_transitionUnit, ← map_transitionUnit,
   172	        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
   173	        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
   174	        trivializationPush_trivializationPush, trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
   175	        show (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T j k) = ρj from
   176	          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f j))).elim _ _,
   177	        show (face₂₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T j k) = ρk from rfl,
   178	        show (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i j) = ρi from rfl,
   179	        show (face₁₂ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i j) = ρj from rfl,
   180	        show (face₁₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclLeft f S T i k) = ρi from
   181	          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f i))).elim _ _,
   182	        show (face₁₃ f T W i j k).comp (inclRight f S T i k) = ρk from
   183	          (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers (f k))).elim _ _]
   184	      exact transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit _ _ _
   185	    have hval := congrArg Units.val key
   186	    simp only [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_map] at hval
   187	    exact hval
   188	
   189	/-! ## The Picard class of the transition cocycle -/
   190	
   191	variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   192	
   193	/-- **Descent identification for locally trivialized modules**: the Picard class of the
   194	descent cocycle associated with the transition cocycle of a family of trivializations of
   195	`N` is the class of `N`.  The assembled trivialization over the cover algebra
   196	intertwines the twisted descent datum of the transition cocycle with the canonical datum
   197	on `B ⊗[A] N` — componentwise this is the defining property of the transition units —
   198	so uniqueness of descent identifies the descended module with `N`. -/
   199	theorem picClass_trivializationCocycle [Module.Invertible A N]
   200	    [Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i, S i)] :
   201	    (isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W
   202	        (isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle f S T W e)).picClass
   203	      = CommRing.Pic.mk A N := by
   204	  set B := ∀ i, S i with hB
   205	  set u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ := cocycleUnit f S T (trivializationCocycle f S T e) with hu'
   206	  set hu := isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W
   207	    (isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle f S T W e)
   208	  set ψ : (B ⊗[A] N) ≃ₗ[B] B := piTrivialization e with hψ
   209	  -- the values of the assembled trivialization on `1 ⊗ₜ n` lie in the descended module
   210	  have hkey : ∀ n : N,
   211	      u.val * descentIncl₁ A B (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) = descentIncl₂ A B (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n)) := by
   212	    intro n
   213	    apply (piDoubleEquiv f S T).injective
   214	    rw [map_mul, piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val, piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₁,
   215	      piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₂]
   216	    funext p
   217	    rw [Pi.mul_apply]
   218	    have hval : ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n) = fun i ↦ e i (1 ⊗ₜ n) := piTrivialization_one_tmul e n
   219	    rw [hval]
   220	    exact trivializationCocycle_mul f S T e p.1 p.2 n
   221	  -- the assembled trivialization intertwines the two descent data
   222	  have he : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] N,
   223	      (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).coaction (ψ x)
   224	        = ((ψ : B ⊗[A] N →ₗ[B] B).restrictScalars A).baseChange B
   225	            ((DescentDatum.baseChange A B N).coaction x) := by
   226	    intro x
   227	    induction x with
   228	    | zero => simp
   229	    | tmul b n =>
   230	        have hb : (b ⊗ₜ[A] n : B ⊗[A] N) = b • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] n) := by
   231	          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
   232	        set s : B := ψ (1 ⊗ₜ n) with hs
   233	        have hψb : ψ (b ⊗ₜ n) = b * s := by
   234	          rw [hb, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
   235	        rw [hψb, ofUnit_coaction, unitCoaction_apply, DescentDatum.baseChange_coaction,
   236	          LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
   237	        have hmul : ((b * s) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B) : B ⊗[A] B)
   238	            = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) := by
   239	          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one]
   240	        have hkey' : u.val * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s := hkey n
   241	        calc u.val * (b * s) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)
   242	            = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * (u.val * (s ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B))) := by
   243	              rw [hmul]; ring
   244	          _ = (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s) := by rw [hkey']

     9	/-!
    10	# Extraction: equal classes differ by a principal divisor
    11	
    12	For the curve bundle `X` (integral, smooth of relative dimension one and quasi-compact
    13	over a field `K`), this file proves the extraction half of the meromorphic bridge
    14	(deg-D2 W4): if two meromorphic presentations present the same Čech Picard class, their
    15	divisors differ by the principal divisor of a single rational function.
    16	
    17	## Route
    18	
    19	Equal classes are, on a common refinement `𝒲`, cohomologous cocycles: there is a
    20	`0`-cochain of unit sections `α` conjugating one into the other. The elements
    21	`c x := P.elem x · (Q.elem x)⁻¹ · germ_η (α x) ∈ K(X)ˣ` then agree for all `x` — the
    22	coboundary identity pushed to `η` is literal equality of field elements (decision D1: no
    23	sheaf gluing) — so they are *one* rational function `g`, and `div g = D_P − D_Q` because
    24	`germ_η (α x)` has trivial order at `x` (`Scheme.ordZ_germGenericUnits`).
    25	
    26	Together with the class law this gives the full characterization
    27	`MeromorphicPresentation.picClass_eq_iff_exists_divOf`: two presentations present the
    28	same class iff their divisors differ by a principal divisor.
    29	-/
    30	
    31	set_option autoImplicit false
    32	
    33	universe u
    34	
    35	open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
    36	
    37	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    38	
    39	namespace Scheme
    40	
    41	namespace MeromorphicPresentation
    42	
    43	/-- Constancy extraction in a commutative group: if `A · (pₓ / p_y) = (qₓ / q_y) · B`
    44	(the coboundary identity at `η`), then `pₓ / qₓ · A = p_y / q_y · B` (the two candidate
    45	rational functions agree). -/
    46	private lemma comm_group_const {G : Type u} [CommGroup G] {A B px py qx qy : G}
    47	    (h : A * (px * py⁻¹) = qx * qy⁻¹ * B) :
    48	    px * qx⁻¹ * A = py * qy⁻¹ * B := by
    49	  have h' := congrArg (· * (py * qx⁻¹)) h
    50	  simp only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h' ⊢
    51	  exact h'
    52	
    53	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    54	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	
    57	/-- **Extraction** (the W4 keystone): if two meromorphic presentations present the same
    58	Čech Picard class, their divisors differ by the principal divisor of a single rational
    59	function. The cobounding unit sections are glued inside `K(X)ˣ`: the elements
    60	`P.elem x · (Q.elem x)⁻¹ · germ_η (α x)` agree as field elements, and their common value
    61	is the required function. -/
    62	theorem exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq {P Q : X.MeromorphicPresentation}
    63	    (h : P.picClass = Q.picClass) :
    64	    ∃ g : X.functionFieldˣ,
    65	      presentationDivisor K P - presentationDivisor K Q
    66	        = Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g := by
    67	  have hmk : CechPic.mk P.cover P.cocycle.class = CechPic.mk Q.cover Q.cocycle.class := h
    68	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩ := CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp hmk
    69	  have hcoh : (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k)).IsCohomologous
    70	      (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k)) :=
    71	    (OneCocycle.class_eq_iff (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k))
    72	      (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k))).mp e
    73	  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp hcoh
    74	  -- the coboundary identity, in `Γ`-typed form
    75	  have hα' : ∀ x y : X,
    76	      X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens x) (α x)
    77	          * unitsEvInf (P.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₁ k)) x y
    78	        = unitsEvInf (Q.cocycle.res fun k => homOfLE (h₂ k)) x y
    79	          * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y ≤ 𝒲.opens y) (α y) :=
    80	    fun x y => hα x y
    81	  -- the candidate rational functions agree as field elements (D1: gluing is equality)
    82	  have hconst : ∀ x y : X,
    83	      P.elem x * (Q.elem x)⁻¹
    84	          * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens x) (α x)
    85	        = P.elem y * (Q.elem y)⁻¹
    86	          * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens y) (α y) := by
    87	    intro x y
    88	    have key := congrArg (germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_inf x y)) (hα' x y)
    89	    rw [map_mul, map_mul, germGenericUnits_unitsRestrict, germGenericUnits_unitsRestrict,
    90	      P.germGenericUnits_unitsEvInf_res h₁ x y, Q.germGenericUnits_unitsEvInf_res h₂ x y]
    91	      at key
    92	    exact comm_group_const key
    93	  -- the common value, read off at the generic-point index
    94	  refine ⟨P.elem (genericPoint X) * (Q.elem (genericPoint X))⁻¹
    95	      * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens (genericPoint X))
    96	        (α (genericPoint X)), ?_⟩
    97	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt fun z hz => ?_
    98	  have hval : Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    99	      (P.elem z * (Q.elem z)⁻¹
   100	        * germGenericUnits (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens z) (α z))
   101	      = Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz (P.elem z)
   102	        * (Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz (Q.elem z))⁻¹ := by
   103	    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv,
   104	      ordZ_germGenericUnits K (𝒲.genericPoint_mem_opens z) (α z) hz (𝒲.mem_opens z),
   105	      mul_one]
   106	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, coeffAt_presentationDivisor, coeffAt_presentationDivisor,
   107	    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_divOf, hconst (genericPoint X) z, hval, toAdd_mul, toAdd_inv,
   108	    sub_eq_add_neg]
   109	
   110	/-- **The meromorphic characterization of the Čech Picard group**: two presentations
   111	present the same class iff their divisors differ by a principal divisor. -/
   112	theorem picClass_eq_iff_exists_divOf {P Q : X.MeromorphicPresentation} :
   113	    P.picClass = Q.picClass
   114	      ↔ ∃ g : X.functionFieldˣ,
   115	          presentationDivisor K P - presentationDivisor K Q
   116	            = Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g := by
   117	  refine ⟨exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq K, ?_⟩
   118	  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
   119	  have hdiv : presentationDivisor K (Q * principal g) = presentationDivisor K P := by
   120	    rw [presentationDivisor_mul, presentationDivisor_principal, ← hg]
   121	    abel
   122	  have hcl := picClass_eq_of_presentationDivisor_eq K hdiv
   123	  rw [picClass_mul, picClass_principal, mul_one] at hcl
   124	  exact hcl.symm
   125	
   126	end MeromorphicPresentation

    10	# Fibre rank of the widened divisor window
    11	
    12	A widened certified adaptation cuts a degree-`g` divisor on every field-valued fibre.
    13	At a high theta window, the function-field dictionary identifies the complete window
    14	with `H^0(O(N(a)))` and its divisor window with `H^0(O(N(a) - d_K))`.  Both divisors
    15	have vanishing `H^1`, so Riemann--Roch and `deg(d_K) = g` show that the quotient has
    16	dimension `g`.
    17	
    18	The theorem below is intrinsic to the cover-independent `divisorWindow`.  In particular,
    19	it does not add a chart-typing premise or transport the widened certificate to an auxiliary
    20	chart adaptation.

   110	/-- On every field-valued fibre, the cover-independent high-window quotient cut out by a
   111	widened degree-`g` certificate has dimension exactly `g`. -/
   112	theorem IsCertified.finrank_windowQuotient_pulledEquations
   113	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   114	    [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
   115	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   116	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
   117	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   118	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   119	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   120	    {a : Nat} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k pi (relThetaCocycle C k pi a)).H1)
   121	    (hMa : windowM_choice pi hpi g ≤ a) :
   122	    Module.finrank K
   123	      ((K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) ⧸
   124	        divisorWindow (A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength) ha1) = g := by
   125	  let dK := A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength
   126	  let E := Scheme.presentationDivisor K dK.presentation
   127	  change Module.finrank K
   128	    ((K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) ⧸
   129	      divisorWindow dK ha1) = g
   130	  have hchiK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : Int) :=
   131	    chi_relCurve_of_chi_aff_rank C g hchi K
   132	  have hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K E = (g : Int) := by
   133	    dsimp [E, dK]
   134	    exact hc.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations (C := C) (R := R) (K := K)
   135	  have hN1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   136	      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) 1) :=
   137	    subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor C K pi a ha1
   138	  have hE1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   139	      (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) 1) :=
   140	    subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor_sub C pi hpi K g a
   141	      ha1 hMa hO hchi hchiK E (by rw [hdeg]; omega)
   142	  have hNrr :
   143	      (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   144	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) : Int)
   145	        = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)
   146	          + Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) :=
   147	    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ hN1
   148	  have hErr :
   149	      (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   150	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) : Int)
   151	        = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)
   152	          + Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) :=
   153	    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ hE1
   154	  have hamb : Module.finrank K
   155	      (K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
   156	      = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   157	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) := by
   158	    calc
   159	      Module.finrank K
   160	          (K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
   161	          = Module.finrank K ↥(⊤ : Submodule K
   162	              (K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   163	                (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))) := by simp
   164	      _ = Module.finrank K ↥(Submodule.map (divFamPhi C K pi a ha1) ⊤) :=
   165	        (finrank_map_divFamPhi C K pi a ha1 ⊤).symm
   166	      _ = Module.finrank K ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
   167	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a) ⊤) := by
   168	        rw [map_divFamPhi_top C K pi a ha1]
   169	      _ = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   170	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) :=
   171	        finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   172	  have hker : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorWindow dK ha1)
   173	      = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   174	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) := by
   175	    calc
   176	      Module.finrank K ↥(divisorWindow dK ha1)
   177	          = Module.finrank K ↥(Submodule.map (divFamPhi C K pi a ha1)
   178	              (divisorWindow dK ha1)) :=
   179	        (finrank_map_divFamPhi C K pi a ha1 _).symm
   180	      _ = Module.finrank K ↥(Scheme.divisorSections K
   181	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E) ⊤) := by
   182	        rw [map_divFamPhi_divisorWindow C K pi a ha1 dK]
   183	      _ = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   184	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) :=
   185	        finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   186	  have hdiffZ :
   187	      (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   188	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) : Int) + (g : Int)
   189	        = (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   190	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) : Int) := by
   191	    rw [hErr, hNrr, sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_add,
   192	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_neg, hdeg]
   193	    ring
   194	  have hdiff :
   195	      Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   196	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) + g
   197	        = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   198	          (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) := by
   199	    exact_mod_cast hdiffZ
   200	  have hq := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank (divisorWindow dK ha1)
   201	  rw [hker, hamb] at hq
   202	  omega

    13	/-!
    14	# The ε frame cover, keyed on the WINDOW QUOTIENT rather than on a carrier
    15	
    16	Roadmap leaf `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.framecover-aff`.
    17	
    18	`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFraming.lean` established that the ε-pair and its pair-chart framing
    19	clause are expressible over the widened carrier, and recorded what it did not do:
    20	
    21	> It does not prove `exists_certChartCover` over the widened carrier — that theorem's proof
    22	> runs the certificate cover and the per-piece frame covers, which is real work and belongs to
    23	> whoever restates it.
    24	
    25	**This file measures that work, and the measurement is the content.**  Inside
    26	`exists_frame_chart_at_prime` the frame-cover keystone `divFamEps_exists_frameCover`
    27	(`Picard/DivSchemeFrameCover.lean:456`) reads its carrier `DivFam C S π g` at **eight** sites, of
    28	**two** kinds:
    29	
    30	* **six** are facts about the window *quotient* — `DivFam.finite_/projective_window_quotient`
    31	  at each of the two ledger windows (:347–357), and `F.window` in the `exists_away_free_pair`
    32	  call (:361, :365).  Constant fibre rank enters separately, through `divFamWindowGr`'s own
    33	  definition.  These are what the layer below restates as hypotheses.
    34	* **two** are *functoriality* of the carrier: `DivFam.window_mapAlg` in the closing `rfl` blocks
    35	  (:426, :443), i.e. "window of `mapAlg` = `windowBaseChange`".  These are **not** window-quotient
    36	  facts, and they are exactly what `windowBaseChange_windowBaseChange` below had to replace.
    37	
    38	Everything downstream of the helper — `exists_component_matrix`,
    39	`exists_det_submatrix_notMem_of_mul_eq_one`, `exists_away_isUnit_of_notMem`,
    40	`map_component_chart` — consumes a Grassmannian *point* and a base ring, and never asks what
    41	produced the submodule.
    42	
    43	*A predecessor version of this paragraph said "exactly three points" and listed
    44	finite/projective/rankAtStalk.  That both under-counted the reads and mis-classified the two
    45	that motivated this file's one new theorem; corrected here (audit `I-1336`).*
    46	
    47	`divisorWindow d hH1` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyWindow.lean:103`) is independent of the
    48	**adaptation** — of which cover refines `d` — which is what lets the declarations below typecheck
    49	carrier-free.  It is **not** independent of the pinned charts: it is a `Submodule.comap` of
    50	`d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ … .V₁ …`, so the fixed two-chart pair
    51	occurs in its definition.  *A predecessor version said "no adaptation, no cover and no chart
    52	typing"; only the first clause is true (`I-1336`).*
    53	
    54	## The one step that is genuinely new
    55	
    56	Restating the layer with the three facts as hypotheses is free, but the tower transport is
    57	not.  The chart-typed `map_divFamWindowGr` (`Picard/DivSchemeFrameCover.lean:188`) proves
    58	`Grassmannian.map β (point over R_h) = point over R_u` by routing through the divisor
    59	*object* — `DivFam.window_mapAlg` on both legs plus `DivFam.mapAlg_comp` — which needs a
    60	carrier with a functorial `mapAlg`.  Carrier-free there is no object to route through, so the
    61	composite must be proved where it actually lives, on the submodule:
    62	
    63	* `windowBaseChange_windowBaseChange` — transitivity of the window pushforward over a tower
    64	  `R → R' → R''`, for an arbitrary `k`-module ambient `H`.  Not in the tree before; both
    65	  inclusions are `windowBaseChange_le_iff` against the compared generators, and the content
    66	  is one `cancelBaseChange` compatibility (`rfl` fails on it, checked).
    67	
    68	## What this does and does NOT establish
    69	
    70	It does **not** produce a widened divisor-representability, and no antecedent of
    71	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` moves.  The window-quotient facts are **hypotheses** in the window
    72	layer.  The `Reachability` section below gives the chart-typed route to them; the correct ledger
    73	for the *widened* route is:
    74	
    75	  the frame cover's chart dependence   REMOVED (this file, sorry-free)
    76	  its window-quotient inputs           reachable chart-typed (below), and reachable WIDENED by
    77	                                       the same three-line proofs through
    78	                                       `AffAdaptation.windowQuotEquiv`
    79	                                       (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffTheta.lean:914`) — whose source
    80	                                       is the SAME quotient — gated on surjectivity of the
    81	                                       widened `thetaGluedEval`, which that file leaves OPEN.
    82	
    83	**Two corrections to predecessor versions of this docstring, both from an audit
    84	(`I-1335`/`I-1337`) that I reproduced before accepting.**  I first wrote that the inputs "reduce
    85	to widened evaluation surjectivity"; I then over-corrected to "the ONE route that exists" plus
    86	"REFUTED on the straddling divisors".  The second is worse than the first and is the one to
    87	retract loudly:
    88	
    89	* the widened route **exists** and is gated on a *missing proof*, not on a refutation;
    90	* and the straddling no-go **cannot** bear on it, because
    91	  `forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling` quantifies over `DivisorAdaptation` while the widened
    92	  route consumes `AffAdaptation`.  On exactly those divisors,
    93	  `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean`) proves
    94	  the *opposite* conjunction: some widened adaptation IS certified while no chart-typed one is.
    95	  So there the widened side is the one that works, and the no-go is evidence *for* it.
    96	
    97	One nuance neither the audit nor I had stated, added here because it is the actual widened
    98	residue: `AffAdaptation.windowQuotEquiv` also takes a `ChartTyping C R π D`, and

   200	/-- **Transitivity of the window pushforward** over a tower `R → R' → R''`.
   201	
   202	This is the step the chart-typed transport did NOT have to prove: `map_divFamWindowGr`
   203	(`Picard/DivSchemeFrameCover.lean:188`) reaches the same conclusion by going *through the
   204	divisor object* — `DivFam.window_mapAlg` on both legs plus `DivFam.mapAlg_comp` — which needs

   206	the composite has to be proved where it lives, on the submodule.
   207	
   208	Both inclusions are `windowBaseChange_le_iff` against the compared generators; the tower
   209	hypothesis enters only as `IsScalarTower`, and `H` is an arbitrary `k`-module. -/
   210	theorem windowBaseChange_windowBaseChange {H : Type u} [AddCommGroup H] [Module k H]
   211	    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   212	    (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
   213	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   214	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
   215	    (N : Submodule R (R ⊗[k] H)) :
   216	    windowBaseChange R'' (windowBaseChange R' N) = windowBaseChange R'' N := by
   217	  -- the `R'`-linear comparison arrow `R' ⊗[k] H → R'' ⊗[k] H` of the upper leg
   218	  set ψ : (R' ⊗[k] H) →ₗ[R'] (R'' ⊗[k] H) :=
   219	    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R' R'' R'' H).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
   220	      (TensorProduct.mk R' R'' (R' ⊗[k] H) 1) with hψdef
   221	  have hψ : ∀ y : R' ⊗[k] H, ψ y
   222	      = TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R' R'' R'' H (1 ⊗ₜ y) :=
   223	    fun _ => rfl
   224	  -- the tower compatibility of the comparison: the two legs agree on the lower generators
   225	  have key : ∀ x : R ⊗[k] H,
   226	      ψ (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' H (1 ⊗ₜ x))
   227	        = TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R'' R'' H (1 ⊗ₜ x) := by
   228	    intro x
   229	    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   230	    | zero => simp
   231	    | add x y hx hy => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
   232	    | tmul r h => simp [hψ]
   233	  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
   234	  · -- `⊆`: test the upper generators, then the lower ones through `ψ`
   235	    rw [windowBaseChange_le_iff]
   236	    have hstep : windowBaseChange R' N
   237	        ≤ Submodule.comap ψ ((windowBaseChange R'' N).restrictScalars R') := by
   238	      rw [windowBaseChange_le_iff]
   239	      intro x hx
   240	      refine Submodule.mem_comap.mpr ?_
   241	      rw [key x]
   242	      exact cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange hx
   243	    intro y hy
   244	    rw [← hψ y]
   245	    exact hstep hy
   246	  · -- `⊇`: a lower generator is `ψ` of an upper generator
   247	    rw [windowBaseChange_le_iff]
   248	    intro x hx
   249	    rw [← key x, hψ]
   250	    exact cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange
   251	      (cancelBaseChange_one_tmul_mem_windowBaseChange hx)

   331	      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))

    11	/-!
    12	# The ε-pair and its pair-chart framing are CARRIER-INDIFFERENT
    13	
    14	The DD-R representability consumer asks for the chart-typed value: `divRepClassifyZar`
    15	(`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) and `divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange`
    16	(`Picard/DivRepChartRange.lean`) both quantify over `DivFamZar`, and the chart data they need
    17	comes from `DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarKit.lean`).  Since the
    18	widened comparison `DivFamZar.toAff` runs chart-typed → widened and has no reverse (a widened
    19	cover has no chart typing to recover, and manufacturing one is the fixed-pair confinement that
    20	protection I-0492 clause 3 forbids), it is natural to read this as "R2 has not reached the
    21	consumer".
    22	
    23	**That reading is wrong, and this file measures why.**  The chart dependency of
    24	`exists_certChartCover` does not run through the divisor's *cover* at all.  It runs through the
    25	**window**:

    30	* the framing clause is two equations between submodules of `R ⊗[k] H`, comparing
    31	  `Module.Grassmannian.map w` of a tautological subbundle against the base change of the window.
    32	  Neither side mentions a cover, a piece, or a chart typing of the divisor.
    33

    35	independent questions, and the widening is invisible to the second.  The declarations below say
    36	that in Lean rather than in prose: both are *statements* about a widened family, and their
    37	elaboration is the content.
    38	
    39	## What this does NOT claim
    40	
    41	It does not prove `exists_certChartCover` over the widened carrier.  What is established here is
    42	that no *type* obstruction stands in the way: the clause is expressible, so the remaining
    43	question is a proof, not a redesign.

    42	/-! ## Coverage from a partition of unity -/
    43	
    44	/-- **Coverage from a partition of unity**: sections `h i` of `V` admitting a partition
    45	`∑ i, a i · h i = 1` have basic opens covering `V` — at a point of `V` not all germs of
    46	the `h i` can be non-units, else `1` would lie in the maximal ideal of the stalk. -/
    47	theorem le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens}
    48	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a h : ι → Γ(X, V)) (hpart : ∑ i, a i * h i = 1) :
    49	    V ≤ ⨆ i, X.basicOpen (h i) := by
    50	  intro x hx
    51	  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
    52	  by_contra hcon
    53	  push Not at hcon
    54	  have hnu : ∀ i : ι, ¬ IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ V x hx (h i)) := by
    55	    intro i hu
    56	    exact hcon i ((X.mem_basicOpen (h i) x hx).mpr hu)
    57	  have h1 : (1 : X.presheaf.stalk x) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    58	    have hg := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ V x hx).hom hpart
    59	    rw [map_one, map_sum] at hg
    60	    rw [← hg]
    61	    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    62	    rw [map_mul]
    63	    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr (hnu i))
    64	  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)

    72	variable {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens) (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ)
    73	
    74	/-! ## Glued sections are determined by their covering-piece components -/
    75	
    76	/-- **Extensionality over a subordinate piece cover**: for a family of opens `P i`
    77	below the gluing pieces `U (σ i)` and covering `W`, two glued sections over `W` whose
    78	`σ i`-components agree on each `W ⊓ P i` are equal. The matching relation writes every
    79	component locally as a multiple of a covering component, and the structure sheaf
    80	separates. -/
    81	theorem gluedSubmodule_ext {W : X.Opens} {ι : Type u} (σ : ι → J) (P : ι → X.Opens)
    82	    (hP : ∀ i : ι, P i ≤ U (σ i)) (hWcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, P i)
    83	    {s t : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)}
    84	    (hst : ∀ i : ι,
    85	      X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hP i) : W ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ U (σ i)) (s.val (σ i)) =
    86	      X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left W (hP i)) (t.val (σ i))) : s = t := by
    87	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
    88	  have hcovj : W ⊓ U j ≤ ⨆ i, W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i := by
    89	    have h1 : W ⊓ U j ≤ (W ⊓ U j) ⊓ ⨆ i, P i :=
    90	      le_inf le_rfl (inf_le_left.trans hWcov)
    91	    rwa [inf_iSup_eq] at h1
    92	  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (X := (X : TopCat)) (C := ModuleCat.{u} k)
    93	    (X.moduleKSheaf k) (fun i => W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i) (W ⊓ U j)
    94	    (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left) hcovj
    95	  intro i
    96	  change X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ U j) (s.val j) =
    97	    X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ U j) (t.val j)
    98	  have hs := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
    99	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)) (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) :
   100	    W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ U j ⊓ U (σ i)))
   101	    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val : ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp
   102	      s.property j (σ i))
   103	  have ht := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   104	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)) (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) :
   105	    W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ U j ⊓ U (σ i)))
   106	    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (t.val : ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp
   107	      t.property j (σ i))
   108	  have hcomp := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   109	      inf_le_right : W ⊓ U j ⊓ P i ≤ W ⊓ P i)) (hst i)
   110	  rw [map_mul] at hs ht
   111	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hs ht hcomp ⊢
   112	  rw [hs, ht, hcomp]

   114	/-! ## The componentwise action of a chart section ring -/
   115	
   116	/-- The **componentwise action** of `r ∈ Γ(X, V)` on glued sections over `W ≤ V`:
   117	`(r • s) j := r↾_{W ⊓ U j} · s j`. The (P1) half of the quasi-coherence packaging of
   118	the glued sheaf on the chart `V`. -/
   119	noncomputable def gluedQsmul {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V))
   120	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) :=
   121	  ⟨fun j => X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hWV : W ⊓ U j ≤ V) r * s.val j, by
   122	    intro i j
   123	    have hs := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val : ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp
   124	      s.property i j
   125	    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
   126	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   127	    rw [hs]
   128	    ring⟩
   129	
   130	@[simp]
   131	lemma gluedQsmul_coe {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V))
   132	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) (j : J) :
   133	    (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s).val j =
   134	      X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hWV : W ⊓ U j ≤ V) r * s.val j :=
   135	  rfl
   136	
   137	/-- The action of `1`. -/
   138	lemma gluedQsmul_one {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V)
   139	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) : gluedQsmul k U g hWV 1 s = s :=
   140	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by rw [gluedQsmul_coe, map_one, one_mul])
   141	
   142	/-- The action of a product. -/
   143	lemma gluedQsmul_mul {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r r' : Γ(X, V))
   144	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
   145	    gluedQsmul k U g hWV (r * r') s =
   146	      gluedQsmul k U g hWV r (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r' s) :=
   147	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
   148	    simp only [gluedQsmul_coe]
   149	    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc])

   151	/-- The action distributes over addition of scalars. -/
   152	lemma gluedQsmul_add_left {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r r' : Γ(X, V))
   153	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
   154	    gluedQsmul k U g hWV (r + r') s =
   155	      gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s + gluedQsmul k U g hWV r' s :=
   156	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
   157	    have hadd : (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s + gluedQsmul k U g hWV r' s).val j =
   158	        (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s).val j + (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r' s).val j := rfl
   159	    rw [hadd, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, map_add, add_mul])
   160	
   161	/-- The action distributes over addition of sections. -/
   162	lemma gluedQsmul_add {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V))
   163	    (s t : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
   164	    gluedQsmul k U g hWV r (s + t) =
   165	      gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s + gluedQsmul k U g hWV r t :=
   166	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
   167	    have hadd : (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s + gluedQsmul k U g hWV r t).val j =
   168	        (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s).val j + (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r t).val j := rfl
   169	    have hst : (s + t).val j = s.val j + t.val j := rfl
   170	    rw [hadd, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, hst, mul_add])
   171	
   172	/-- The action commutes with the `k`-module structure (the `smul_qsmul` datum of the
   173	two-cover pair). -/
   174	lemma gluedQsmul_smul {V W : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) (c : k)
   175	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
   176	    gluedQsmul k U g hWV r (c • s) = c • gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s :=
   177	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
   178	    have hcs : ((c • s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W))).val j = c • s.val j := rfl
   179	    have hcs' : ((c • gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s :
   180	        ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W))).val j = c • (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s).val j := rfl
   181	    rw [hcs', gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, hcs, Scheme.overModule_smul_def,
   182	      Scheme.overModule_smul_def, mul_left_comm])

   184	/-- The action is natural under restriction of glued sections (the `secRes_qsmul`
   185	axiom of the packaging). -/
   186	lemma gluedRes_gluedQsmul {V W' W : X.Opens} (hW'W : W' ≤ W) (hWV : W ≤ V)
   187	    (r : Γ(X, V)) (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
   188	    gluedRes k U g hW'W (gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s) =
   189	      gluedQsmul k U g (hW'W.trans hWV) r (gluedRes k U g hW'W s) :=
   190	  Subtype.ext (funext fun j => by
   191	    rw [gluedRes_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedRes_coe, map_mul]
   192	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

   196	lemma gluedTriv_gluedQsmul (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g) {V W : X.Opens}
